title: William Perwich? → Sir William Temple: letter from Paris with "a long passage in code"
shelfmark: Beinecke, Osborn Manuscript Files, OSB MSS FILE 11791 (box 118)
status: Finding aid: "Letter includes a long passage in code." The name is cut by a page break in the PDF; the neighbours are Perwich items. File 1410 in the same series is "Mr. Perwich's Cypher" (c. 1668-72), endorsed by Blathwayt. Perwich's 1670 transposition paragraph to Arlington was only solved in 2025 (Biermann and Lasry; Brown; TNA report, per cryptiana unsolved.htm). This letter a year earlier may share the system.
why: Paris to The Hague on the eve of Dover; Perwich's Despatches (Curran 1903) are printed, to Arlington rather than Temple.
